name: Santos Express Restaurant
address: Santos Bay, Mossel Bay, 6506, South Africa
description_short: Dine inside a vintage train carriage perched on Mossel Bay's beachfront with ocean views and fresh seafood.
description_long:
Santos Express isn't just a restaurant – it's a piece of railway history converted into one of the Garden Route's most unique dining experiences. Set in restored train carriages right on Santos Beach, this quirky spot offers front-row seats to Mossel Bay's dramatic coastline. The sound of waves provides the soundtrack as you tuck into generous plates of fresh linefish, calamari, and prawns.

The menu leans heavily on seafood, which makes sense given the ocean is literally metres away, but there's plenty for landlubbers too – steaks, burgers, and pub-style classics done well. The atmosphere is relaxed and unpretentious, with families, surfers, and travellers all finding their way here. Service can be slow when it's busy, but the setting more than makes up for any wait.

This is Mossel Bay at its most laid-back. Grab a window seat if you can, order the catch of the day, and watch the waves roll in. It's the kind of place that reminds you why people holiday on this stretch of coast.
